welcome_ubbc:
🍺 Welcome to UBBC Bot!

📋 General:
/start - Show this help
/help [section] - Show help for specific section

🛍️ Orders:
/list_offers [user] - View available offers (admin: add 'user' for customer view)
/order <offer_id> [quantity] - Place an order
/confirm_order <offer_id> <quantity> - Confirm duplicate order
/my_orders [id] - View your orders

🔔 Notifications:
/subscribe - Subscribe to offer notifications
/unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications

👑 Admin:
/box_status [active|ordered|completed|delivered|all] - View box status
admin_sections_available:
👑 Admin sections available: suppliers, offers, orders, users
Use /help [section] for detailed commands
help_sections:
📚 Help Sections:

📋 [/help general](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_general) - Basic commands
🛍️ [/help orders](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_orders) - Order management
admin_help_sections:
👑 Admin Sections:

🏢 [/help suppliers](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_suppliers) - Supplier management
🍺 [/help offers](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_offers) - Offer management
👥 [/help users](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_users) - User management
📦 [/help delivery](https://t.me/{bot_username}?start=help_delivery) - Delivery management
help_general:
📋 General Commands:

/start - Show main help
/help [section] - Show help for specific section
/list_offers [user] - View available offers (admin: add 'user' for customer view)
/subscribe - Subscribe to offer notifications
/unsubscribe - Unsubscribe from notifications
help_orders:
🛍️ Order Commands:

/order <offer_id> [quantity] - Place an order
/confirm_order <offer_id> <quantity> - Confirm duplicate order
/my_orders [id] - View your orders
help_suppliers:
🏢 Supplier Management:

/add_supplier <name> - Add supplier
/retire_supplier <name> - Retire supplier
/list_suppliers [active|retired|all] - List suppliers
/edit_supplier <name> - Edit supplier details
help_offers:
🍺 Offer Management:

/create_offer <supplier> <name> <price> <box_size> - Create draft offer
/offer_details <offer_id> - View and edit offer details
/preview_offer <offer_id> - Preview offer appearance
/publish_offer <offer_id> - Publish draft offer
/cancel_offer <offer_id> - Cancel offer and all orders
/add_box <offer_id> - Add box to offer
/box_status [active|ordered|completed|delivered|all] - View box status
/order_wholesale <offer_id> - Start wholesale ordering process
help_users:
👥 User Management:

/pending_users - View users awaiting approval
/list_users - View all customers
/approve_user <username> - Approve user
/reject_user <username> - Reject user
/user_status <username> - Check user status
/update_user <username> <first_name> [last_name] - Update name
/order_for <username> <offer_id> [quantity] - Place order for user
/cancel_order <order_id> - Cancel customer order
/user_orders <username> - View orders for user
/all_orders [status] - Download CSV of orders
help_delivery:
📦 Delivery Management:

/wholesale_delivery - Process wholesale deliveries
/send_overviews - Send delivery overviews to customers
/mark_paid - Mark customers as paid
/create_discount <percentage> [hours] - Create discount
/cancel_discount - Cancel active discount
/discount_status - View discount status
